features.title: Overlay chat and approval
steps: Press Super+Shift+J to open Jarvis.

steps.text: Type: hello. Confirm a reply appears without a Run button.
Type: switch to workspace 1. Inspect the proposed-action bubble — it should read as a scannable card (a friendly title like "Switch to workspace 1"), not a below-bubble text dump.

steps: Choose Cancel and confirm the desktop was not changed.

steps.text: Type: open my planning in a new workspace. Inspect the proposed-action bubble before approving — the skill's description (which apps, on a new workspace) should appear inside the bubble itself, and the line above the bubble should just say "Review the plan below.", not repeat the description.
steps.prompt: open my planning in a new workspace

features.expected: Chat replies immediately. Actions wait for approval and Cancel performs no action.

features.title: Open planning workspace
steps: Press Super+Shift+J; type: open my planning in a new workspace.
Check that the proposed skill is open-planning; choose Run.
Confirm Todoist, Google Calendar, Outlook and WhatsApp are together on a fresh workspace.
features.expected: The four planning apps appear together; existing matching app windows may be moved.

features.title: Scratchpad and Outlook
steps: Focus a disposable terminal or other window you are comfortable moving.
Open Jarvis; type: move this window to scratchpad and open email.
Inspect the scratch-and-mail plan and choose Run.
Press Super+S to reveal the original window; check that Outlook opened.
features.expected: The original window moves to scratchpad and Outlook opens.

features.title: Bug and feature intake
steps: Open Jarvis; type: /report validation test only.
Answer one clarifying question, then choose Skip.
Inspect the full bug draft and select Cancel to avoid filing a test issue.
Repeat with /feature validation idea, then Cancel.
features.expected: Both routes ask deterministic questions and show the draft before filing. Cancel creates no issue.

features.title: Post-run feedback
steps: Ask Jarvis to say hello.
Choose neutral feedback and reopen Training. Confirm the run appears under review-later problems.
On another completed hello run choose Report.
Confirm bug intake starts for that rated prompt, then Cancel.
features.expected: Neutral feedback remains local; Report refers to the rated run and requires a reviewed filing step.

features.title: Follow execution and reopen state
steps: Ask Jarvis to open Outlook and approve its reviewed plan.
Watch the step list finish.
Close Jarvis and reopen with Super+Shift+J.
features.expected: The result and feedback are visible again on reopen; the console targets that run.

features.title: Slash-command autocomplete
steps: Type / in the empty chat input.
Use Down and Up to select a command; press Tab.
Confirm completion inserts the command without sending it.
Clear the input, type /rep, press Enter, and confirm /report is inserted.
Type / again and press Esc; confirm only the suggestions close.
features.expected: Prefix suggestions are keyboard navigable; completion does not execute, and first Esc dismisses the list.

features.title: Training window, problem triage and confirmed handoffs
steps: Open Jarvis with Super+Shift+J, then choose Open Training or submit /train. Confirm Training has its own floating window and chat stays available.
Open Training again from chat. Confirm it focuses the same window. Resize it and inspect version, metrics and the sample/period note.
Switch between Problems, Validate features, Assignments and Agent monitor. Confirm only the selected panel is shown.
Select a problem. Inspect original run/version/path context, edit title and expected outcome, set priority P1 and Save. Refresh and confirm those edits persist.
Mark the problem Done; filter Done and Reopen it. Repeat with Dismiss. Preview Delete and Cancel; confirm it remains.
Choose Save & generate agent assignment. Inspect the linked draft in Assignments. Preview Save / Add and inspect title, priority, notes and original evidence. Cancel to avoid creating an assignment.
Only for an improvement you want, preview again and confirm. Choose Hand off to agent, preview/confirm the handoff, then check the paste-ready text and verify no agent was contacted automatically.
features.expected: Training is a separate focusable window with clear panels. Problem triage survives refresh; original evidence is retained. Assignment generation and local deletion require confirmation; priority and edits appear in the brief.

features.title: Guided human validation
steps: Open Training and choose Validate features. Pick any pending feature.
For a step marked with a Run this step button, click it and confirm it submits the prompt for you and shows the reply, without you retyping anything in chat.
Confirm the evidence run id field fills in automatically from that Run this step click, without you having to find or type one yourself.
Complete the remaining steps and record an actual outcome note, then Verify; inspect the confirmation preview and Cancel first.
If you really completed the test, repeat and confirm. Confirm the guide closes and the feature disappears from the default pending list.
Check Include previously validated features. Confirm the feature you just verified shows its result (date, version, outcome, notes) directly in the list, without clicking in.
For a real failure on a different feature, choose Fail, confirm, then Draft bug report.
features.expected: Unconfirmed results do not persist. Confirmed results carry date/version/notes; failure can enter reviewed bug intake.

features.title: Open any installed app by name
steps: Press Super+Shift+J.
Type: open spotify. Inspect the plan and approve with Run.
Confirm Spotify opens or focuses if already running.
Repeat the request and confirm the same Spotify window is focused, without a duplicate.
If two apps share a name (e.g. Bitwarden native + Flatpak): type open bitwarden, approve, then type no, the other bitwarden. Inspect the close+open plan, approve with Run.
Confirm the first window closed and the other match opened. Type open bitwarden again and confirm the corrected match is now the default.
features.expected: An installed app is resolved by name, opened or focused. A repeated request focuses the existing window. After 'the other one', the previous owned window closes, the next match opens, and future opens prefer that match.

features.title: Training assignment editing, generation and handoff
steps: Open Training and choose Assignments. Inspect the queue status, area, priority and parallel badges.
Select an unclaimed queued assignment. Edit its title or goal, then Refresh; confirm your unsaved edits remain. Preview Save / Add and Cancel; verify the brief and queue have not changed.
Only for an edit you want, preview again and Confirm. Reload the assignment and confirm the brief, queue and index agree. Verify original context and ownership notes remain.
If an assignment is in progress, select it and confirm its editor is read-only.
Choose New assignment (discard prior edits if needed). Link an optional problem and confirm its title, area, notes and priority are inherited.

Enter an expected outcome and choose Local Ollama → Generate draft. Confirm a draft fills the form without writing files. Review and edit it; if the model is unavailable, confirm the error leaves the form usable.
Choose On-machine coding agent → Prepare agent prompt. Confirm Jarvis only shows a prompt to copy, and does not launch an agent. If desired, paste it into your chosen agent and import its JSON draft.

For a real wanted draft, preview Save / Add and Confirm. Choose Hand off to agent; confirm Agent monitor opens with that assignment selected. Preview the handoff and Cancel unless you intend to save it.
features.expected: Only confirmed saves update real assignment files and metadata. Owned work cannot be edited; drafts preserve linked evidence and selected scope. Local generation and manual prompt preparation write nothing. Handoff preselects the saved assignment and never auto-dispatches an agent.

features.title: Agent manager: visible agents and personal auto-queues
steps: Open Training and choose Agent manager. Confirm horizontally stacked, color-coded agent tiles appear at the top with idle / working / waiting / blocked / error labels and each tile's ordered personal queue directly underneath.

Select a Cursor / Codex slot. Confirm its effective reasoning depth and source are shown. Choose Low, Medium, High or Ultra (xhigh), preview a handoff and confirm it; verify the selected depth remains on that slot after refresh.

Read the reasoning-depth help. Confirm it says the choice applies only when a new Codex window starts and that focusing an existing session cannot change its depth. Confirm Claude Code and Human slots say this launcher does not control their depth.

In Available work, select a claimable assignment and an existing tile, or choose + New agent. Confirm the normal flow automatically chooses cold-start versus continue; manual template choice appears only in Advanced prompt override.
Choose Start visibly now, confirm a handoff for an idle non-human slot, and verify a real visible terminal opens or focuses while the exact prompt remains available for you to paste.
Add at least two future assignments to one agent's queue. Confirm their ids, titles and ready-next / blocked-waiting states appear under that tile in FIFO order.

After the current assignment becomes done on origin/main, leave Agent manager open for one refresh interval. Confirm the next claimable personal item becomes current and a visible window opens/focuses with its prompt displayed, but the prompt is not pasted or submitted.
Use Mark slot busy or Mark slot idle; review and confirm. Verify the copy says this is local metadata and does not claim to detect, start or stop a Codex or Claude process.
Inspect the Queue board. Confirm it lists assignment id/status/area/parallel policy, identifies blocked rows as waiting, and names the current worker when a slot holds that assignment.
features.expected: Agent tiles make status and per-agent FIFO work visible at a glance. Available work reuses canonical claimability. Confirmed queues auto-advance only by preparing the next handoff and opening/focusing a visible window; Jarvis never pastes, submits, or silently spends agent credits.
